description: Hook commands declared in the checkout's .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json — shell commands wired to fire on agent events such as tool use, session start or prompt submit. Shows the command, its trigger, and whether the script it references lives inside the repo, outside it, or is missing.

dir.description: Absolute path to the checkout to inspect. Defaults to WI_DEFAULT_ROOT if set, otherwise the server's working directory.

name: auto_run_commands
title: Commands this checkout wires to agent events
